title: Registry
about: OCI distribution. Pull models and artifacts with the client you already have.

inventory.note: `described` counts what the page indexes, most of it held by Docker Hub, Artifact Hub and Microsoft Artifact Registry and pulled from those. `served_here` is what this registry serves bytes for -- the only ones /v2/ can give you.

catalog_note: this section has no snapshot: /v2/_catalog is live truth, and a snapshot of somebody else's registry would be a claim we cannot keep

fetch.note: the digest is the sha256 of the bytes

verify.expected_from: the catalog, the tree listing or the manifest -- never the source that served the bytes
